# langsmith_run_share (Resource)

Manages the public share state of a run. Creating this resource generates a share token; destroying it unshares the run.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "langsmith_run_share" "demo_trace" {
  run_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}

output "run_share_token" {
  value = langsmith_run_share.demo_trace.share_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `run_id` (String) UUID of the run to share.

### Optional

- `workspace_id` (String) If set, overrides the provider-level `workspace_id` for all API calls made by this resource.

### Read-Only

- `share_token` (String, Sensitive) The generated share token (used as the path segment in shared URLs). This is an unauthenticated capability: anyone with the token can read the shared run, which may contain end-user content, so it is treated as sensitive and redacted from plan output.
